title: Build a 2d Fighting game with Me
author: No_Veterinarian2042
selftext: I am about to get a half finished 2D web based fighting game. The dev(university student) couldn't finish it off as he was too busy. So i will be getting what is done and hoping to finish it. If you have vibe coded a game or are interested to learn(with me) then Let me know. This will be a first for me. I'm in Australia so if time zone is too off, i understand, if it isn't a big deal, let's make it work.

replies.author: No_Veterinarian2042
replies.body: It was meant to be a crypto fighting game where the executives/influencers of the industry fight, like street fighter with crypto theme. It is meant to be satire of how stupid and insane the industry can be. P.S i ended up building from scratch as the uni dev was building with GDScript on Godot engine which is practically impossible for AI. But i have been using AI to generate my characters(2 so far, cz(main boss/villain) and a warrior(for users)) and background setting. If this goes well, i plan on making a series of satire games targeting the industry. Will have to find more creatives first. DM if still interested.
